profile_text: With a strong focus on expanding the French luxury marketplace, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced rapid growth, increasing its workforce by 291.7% to 1,042 employees in 2024. As a leading player in the wholesale and retail trade sector, the company's success can be attributed to its strategic efforts in developing a premier online platform for luxury goods. Under the leadership of Dominik P, the company continues to drive innovation and expansion in the European market.
